the drop-in test of R407C is not recommended in this screw chiller with a shell-and-tube condenser/evaporator.
the performance reduction of the chiller using R407C is mainly caused by the heat transfer degradation in using the mixed-refrigerant.

the heat transfer performance in the evaporator should be considered carefully when substituting R22 by R407C in a screw chilter.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the heat transfer in a heat exchanger is the most critical issue to be considered when using a mixed refrigerant as a substitute for a single refrigerant.
the heat transfer degradation in a shell-and-tube evaporator is a major factor causing the chiller performance degradation when substituting the original refrigerant to a mixed refrigerant.
the performance of the chiller with shell and tube heat exchangers is more sensitive to the refrigerant properties than that of the chiller without the heat exchangers.
